blocks.html: All joints shall be brazed with a brazing procedure developed and qualified in accordance with the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section IX (Welding and Brazing Qualifications) or in accordance with AWS B2.2 standard for Brazing Procedure and Performance Qualification.
